                  Notice of Hearing Participation

TO THE HONORABLE ADMINISTRATIVE LAW JUDGES:
        COMES NOW, Glenn Hodge, Ryan Hodge, Schwertner Farms, Inc., JT
Carothers Holdings, LLC, and MCP 18 LLC (Hodge et al.), under SOAH Order No. 6,
to submit this list of witnesses and counsel who will participate in the hearing on the
merits.
                         Attendees for Hearing on the Merits


 Attendee Name                 Type                          Method of Appearance
 Bradford W. Bayliﬀ            Attorney                      In-Person
 Brian C. Andrews              Expert                        Videoconference


        The following Hodge et al. intervenor witnesses may be required to participate in
the hearing: Glenn Hodge, Ryan Hodge, Stacy Hodge, James Schwertner, Jason
Carothers. The method of appearance for each of those witnesses is undecided, but they
all request the ability to participate via videoconference.


       Counsel for Hodge et al. conferred with persons associated with the Save Our
Salado (SOS) Group. Several of those intervenors ﬁled direct testimony. If their presence


                                           1 of 2
 is required, they also request the ability to participate via videoconference but may be able
to attend in person.
        Between the Hodge et al. group and the Save Our Salado (SOS) group, there are
over sixty individuals and entities who intervened. After discussions between the groups,
counsel for Hodge et al. notiﬁes the ALJs, Oncor, and LCRA TSC that there could be ﬁve
to ten people who want to attend and participate in the hearing on any one day. If
information becomes known about a change in the likely number of persons who wish to
attend, this notice will be updated.
